description: Compound-v2 fork with no enforced initial-seed-deposit on listed markets. Attacker minted 1 wei of an empty hToken, donated underlying directly to the market to inflate the exchange rate, borrowed against the inflated collateral, and looped. Compound prod was protected by a guardian-required seed deposit that Hundred's Optimism deployment did not enforce. vulnerable_contract is the empty hWBTC market on Optimism that the attacker manipulated by donating WBTC directly to inflate the exchange rate.
